Both Isopropyl caprate and Cannabisin D are known to interact with the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, indicating a possible downstream effect of the compound in the signaling or transport processes. The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction. The mechanism appears to involve the compound acting as a target of other compounds, which then exert their effects on the transporter.
